statement: Combined FY2027 capex of the 5 largest AI/cloud spenders >= 1.2x FY2026 (Securities filings; on FY2027 filings)
status_at_phase_end: Not resolvable in Dec 2022. No capex filings fell in the window (Q4/FY2022 results were published from late January 2023, excluded). In-window evidence is trade-press reporting that one top spender paused or 'rescoped' around a dozen data-centre builds to redesign them for AI workloads; the latest pre-window filing showed that spender's quarterly capex near $9.5 bn.

items.summary: Pre-window baseline: a top AI/cloud spender reported Q3 2022 capital expenditures (including finance-lease principal) of $9.52 bn while revenue fell 4% year on year.
items.detail: Meta, 'Meta Reports Third Quarter 2022 Results', 2022-10-26 (verified via web_extract this run). Forward 2023 capex guidance in the release was not in the extracted text and is not recorded.

items.summary: Trade press (exclusive): a top spender cancelled one data-centre expansion and was reworking ('rescoping') its other under-development projects for a new design for AI workloads, likely delaying construction timelines; the firm said AI at scale needs a different type of data centre.
items.detail: DatacenterDynamics (Sebastian Moss), 'Exclusive: After Meta cancels Odense data center expansion, projects are being rescoped globally', 2022-12-14 (verified via web_extract this run); 11 under-development projects affected.

items.summary: The same spender confirmed a temporary construction pause at a large data centre begun that spring, to change its design; trade press reported it was redesigning data centres for AI workloads, with new designs not yet final.
items.detail: DatacenterDynamics, 'Meta pauses construction on Temple, Texas, data center as part of AI rescope', 2022-12-16 (verified via web_extract this run; includes company statement).

items.summary: No securities filing with capex data from the five largest spenders was published inside the window; full-year 2022 figures appeared only from late January 2023 and are excluded under the as-of rule.
items.detail: Q3 2022 10-Qs were filed in late October 2022 (pre-window); Q4/FY2022 10-Ks and earnings releases followed in Jan-Feb 2023. Reference page opened this run: Meta Q3 2022 results release.
